card.name: Words inside 'in ...' opening phrases
card.fires_on: Words or a comma inside an opening 'in/at/as in' phrase, just before the phrase's noun or main clause arrives, as in 'In an individual ... opioids,' or 'in the frontal'.

modes.description: A determiner or modifier right after 'in', 'at' or 'as in' where a setting noun is expected.

modes.label: Setting word in general text
modes.description: A word like 'daily' that leads into a noun such as life.
modes.example: use their previously paralyzed limbs in<< daily>> life.

card.writes: It favors Chinese phrases meaning 'under conditions' or 'in circumstances', so it adds a setting-or-condition phrase.
card.plain: It fires in short opening phrases that set a condition or setting, like 'in someone dependent on opioids,' or 'in daily life'.
